summary: Initial release of RepairMate — your DIY home repair companion. Approved and live on the App Store. Step-by-step repair guides, emergency reference, diagnostic trees, building codes, wiring reference, and more. Works fully offline.
included: 8 free modules: Repair Guides, Search, Emergency Quick Reference, Bookmarks, Quick Tips, Repair Glossary, Browse by Room, Categories
8 premium Pro modules: Cost Estimator (DIY vs Pro), Tool Box, Shopping List, Repair History, Stats Dashboard, Home Profile, Seasonal Maintenance, Skill Assessment
4 Pro+ modules: Job Tracker, Diagnostics, Pro Pricing, Material Calc
20 bundled repair guides across 7 categories (Plumbing, Walls, Doors, Electrical, Kitchen, Bathroom, General)
Emergency quick reference for 8 critical situations (gas leak, burst pipe, electrical fire, etc.)
Diagnostic trees for troubleshooting common home problems
Building codes reference with NEC/IRC codes
Wiring reference charts (AWG, amperage, breaker sizes)
Permit guide — what requires permits and what doesn't
Seasonal maintenance with 23 tasks organized by Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter
10-question skill assessment quiz to find your DIY level
25 quick tips and 27 glossary terms for home maintenance
Premium content with one-time in-app purchase ($3.99)
StoreKit 2 (iOS) and Google Play Billing (Android) integration
100% offline — all data stored locally, no accounts, no tracking
Full cross-platform feature parity between iOS and Android
